material-rgb.title: Material function · Literal byte palette
material-rgb.label: RGB bytes to linear color
material-rgb.description: The target rgb calls admit only literal integer bytes. Their colors are then mixed using amount. rgb(32,96,208) equals #2060D0; rgb(240,144,48) equals #F09030.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: A channel above 255 is outside the literal byte range.

material-sin.title: Material function · Sine cycle
material-sin.label: One explicit scalar cycle
material-sin.description: amount maps to an authored angle from 0 to2π radians. Remapping sin from[-1,1] to[0,1] admits a color mix. This is an input curve, not an automatic clock.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Trigonometric entries are approximate mathematical values; do not assert bitwise shader equality.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: sin requires a float argument, not a color.

material-cos.title: Material function · Cosine cycle
material-cos.label: Start at the warm endpoint
material-cos.description: The same authored0..2π angle starts at the cosine peak. amount 0 and1 give the warm endpoint; amount .5 gives the cold endpoint.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Trigonometric entries are approximate mathematical values; do not assert bitwise shader equality.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: The inferred argument 2000 exceeds the ±1000-radian function limit.

material-radians.title: Material function · Degree conversion
material-radians.label: Normalize a half turn
material-radians.description: amount 0..1 represents0..180 degrees. radians converts that angle to0..π; division by the admitted nonzero literalπ normalizes the mix ratio. The final clamp retains the declared0..1 envelope.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Trigonometric entries are approximate mathematical values; do not assert bitwise shader equality.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: The inferred argument 2000 exceeds the ±1000-degree conversion limit.

material-pow.title: Material function · Quadratic response
material-pow.label: Square an admitted amount
material-pow.description: The unsigned literal exponent 2 lowers to repeated multiplication. Half input gives quarter ratio, so the response begins more slowly than the linear palette.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: The exponent must be an unsigned integer literal from 2 through 8.

material-abs.title: Material function · Symmetric magnitude
material-abs.label: Cold center and warm ends
material-abs.description: The authored input first maps to[-1,1]. abs returns its magnitude; the midpoint is zero and both endpoints are one. This does not introduce an exact-distance field or a geometry operation.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: abs refuses an inferred argument outside±1000.

material-min.title: Material function · Upper response cap
material-min.label: Stop at sixty percent
material-min.description: min takes the smaller scalar. Inputs above .6 keep ratio .6 rather than reaching the warm endpoint. This is a scalar upper cap, not a shader conditional.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: Both inferred min argument ranges must remain within±1000.

material-max.title: Material function · Lower response floor
material-max.label: Start at forty percent
material-max.description: max takes the larger scalar. Inputs below .4 keep ratio .4; the cold endpoint is unreachable with this admitted input range.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: Both inferred max argument ranges must remain within±1000.

material-clamp.title: Material function · Bounded central response
material-clamp.label: Keep quarter-to-three-quarter color
material-clamp.description: The scalar stays within the explicit ordered limits. Neither source endpoint color is reached: amount 0 produces ratio.25 and amount 1 produces ratio.75.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: The lower inferred bound cannot exceed the upper inferred bound.

material-smoothstep.title: Material function · Smooth central transition
material-smoothstep.label: Literal edges and flat endpoints
material-smoothstep.description: The literal edges .2 and .8 normalize and clamp the input before the t*t*(3-2*t) polynomial. The response stays at zero below .2 and at one above .8.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: Edges must be ordered with reciprocal 1/(hi-lo) at most 1000; equal edges refuse.

material-mix.title: Material function · Scalar and color interpolation
material-mix.label: Inset endpoints using both overloads
material-mix.description: The target float mix interpolates constants .2 and .8 into a scalar ratio. The fragment then uses the color mix overload. This example deliberately stays inside the full color-mix0..1 contract.

expected.basis: Source-backed scalar interpretation; not CPU shader evaluation or observed pixels.
expected.comparison: Scalar ratios describe the authored function; screen pixels also include actual mesh lighting and framebuffer conversion.
expected.colorSpace: mix operates on linear channels obtained from literal bytes using (byte/255)^2.2, not direct sRGB byte averages.

refusal.reason: A color mix ratio with inferred value -.1 is outside0..1.
